$comment: Copy and metadata for the volunteer page.

seo.title: Volunteer With Us | EireTech360 Ireland
seo.description: Join EireTech360's Ireland chapter as a volunteer and help make digital knowledge, creativity and opportunity more welcoming for the local community.

hero.title: Your time can [g]open new possibilities.[/g]
hero.subtitle: We warmly welcome volunteers who want to share their skills, curiosity and energy with the EireTech360 Ireland chapter and the people around it.

ireland.label: Ireland vision
ireland.title: A more open digital future is built together.
ireland.body: Our Ireland chapter is shaped by the belief that useful digital knowledge, creativity and opportunity should feel welcoming, not out of reach.

introduction.label: A genuine welcome
introduction.title: Bring what you know. Help someone else move forward.
introduction.body: Whether you have experience in technology, design, marketing, storytelling or community support, your contribution can help make a shared initiative more useful and more human.
highlights: A respectful space for ideas, different experiences and practical skills.
A chance to contribute in a way that connects with your interests.
A shared focus on making digital opportunities feel more accessible.

opportunities.label: Where you could contribute
opportunities.title: Small contributions can create real momentum.
opportunities.body: Volunteer pathways can begin with the skills you already have. We will discuss what is useful, realistic and meaningful together.

items.title: Community support
items.text: Help create a friendly, inclusive experience for people taking their first steps into digital topics.

items.title: Storytelling & creative work
items.text: Use writing, design, photography or content skills to make ideas clearer and more welcoming.

items.title: Digital skills sharing
items.text: Share a practical tip, tool or way of thinking that could help someone feel more confident online.

items.title: Outreach & collaboration
items.text: Support the connections and conversations that help a local initiative grow with care.

journey.label: How we begin
journey.title: A welcoming route from interest to contribution.
journey.body: There is no one-size-fits-all volunteer profile. We start by understanding what you enjoy, what you can offer and how you would like to take part.

items.title: Say hello
items.text: Tell us a little about yourself, the causes you care about and the skills you would like to share.

items.title: Find a useful place
items.text: We will talk about the kind of contribution that aligns with your time, interests and strengths.

items.title: Create momentum together
items.text: Join a conversation, share an idea and help shape a more welcoming path for others.

companion.label: Careers & internships
companion.title: Are you looking for an early-career learning path instead?
companion.body: Explore the careers page for internship and development-focused opportunities with the EireTech360 Ireland chapter.

cta.label: We would love to meet you
cta.title: Your welcome starts with a simple introduction.
cta.body: Tell us how you would like to contribute. We will be pleased to begin the conversation with you.
